note: Stock markets calmed down today, and the VIX fear index fell to 19.5. Mortgage rates are 7.18% and the 10-year Treasury yield closed at 4.98%, so borrowing remains expensive. The single-family homes & condos score is 53 (Elevated, down 1.1) and the apartment buildings (5+ units) score is 48 (Elevated, up 4.1).

vix.detail: Down from 19.92 the day before. The long-term average is about 19.5. The score uses the 20-market-day average (19.3), so a one-day jump moves it less.

credit.detail: High-grade company bonds paid 6.02%, or 0.89 percentage points more than the 10-year Treasury that month. That is near the low end of the past 20 years: lenders are comfortable.

mort.detail: A year ago it was 6.22%. Down from 7.40% in October.

unemp.detail: Seasonally adjusted: San Francisco–Oakland area 4.2%, San Jose area 4.0%, weighted by the size of each labor force. The U.S. rate is 4.2%. Tech jobs are down 2.4% from a year ago.

supply.detail: Santa Clara County, from Realtor.com: about 2.5 active listings for every home under contract, 26% more listings than a year ago, and 32% of listings with a price cut.

hp.detail: Average of the FHFA house price indexes for the San Francisco–San Mateo, Oakland–Berkeley and San Jose areas. Prices are lower than a year ago.

valueF.detail: Home prices compared with San Francisco-area rents are about 2% above their 2005–2025 average.

sloos.detail: In the Federal Reserve's survey of bank loan officers, a net 5% of large banks said they tightened their standards for apartment-building loans.

vacRel.detail: California rental vacancy from the U.S. Census Bureau was 4.8%, about 0.3 points below its 2005–2025 average of 5.1%. It is statewide and yearly, so it changes slowly.

rentCPI.detail: Rent paid by tenants in the San Francisco–Oakland area (consumer price index for rent). It covers all leases, so it moves more slowly than asking rents.

pipe.detail: 27,609 homes were permitted in the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas over the past 24 months, about 17% below the 2005–2025 average pace.

baa.detail: Baa-rated company bonds paid 1.51 percentage points more than the 10-year Treasury (Moody's, via FRED). That is near the low end of the past 20 years: lenders are comfortable.

ndx.detail: The Nasdaq-100 closed at 27,907.63, 10.6% below its 12-month high of 31,224.69 on Oct 6.

supplyP.detail: Single-family homes in Santa Clara County had 1.6 months of supply (MLS data). Condos are slower, at 4.1 months. 31% of listings have cut their price (Realtor.com, September).

cs.detail: S&P Cotality Case-Shiller San Francisco home price index (seasonally adjusted). Prices are higher than a year ago.

value.detail: Case-Shiller San Francisco home prices compared with San Francisco-area rents are about 12% above their 2005–2025 average.

cap.detail: Average for all San Francisco Bay Area apartment buildings (CoStar), up from 5.5% a year ago. Newer, high-end buildings sell at about 4.25–4.65%, which is below the Treasury yield.

vac.detail: Apartment vacancy across the San Francisco Bay Area (CoStar). A year ago it was 4.8%.

rent.detail: Average asking apartment rent across the San Francisco Bay Area is $2,910 a month (CoStar).

ins.detail: U.S. consumer price index for tenants' and household insurance.

hpSJ.detail: FHFA index for the San Jose–Sunnyvale–Santa Clara area: down 1.0% from a year ago.

valueSJ.detail: San Jose-area home prices compared with rents: about 9% above normal.

warn.detail: 3,221 workers are covered by layoff notices filed in the last 30 days.
